messages:
Vera (People Ops): Quick sync  rolling out a concise handbook amendment: 'Schedule exception attestations & manager checklist'. Goal: <300 words, clear manager steps, and a short 10-min micro-training. Need two quick wording reviewers and one owner to run RSVP + completion tracker. Also flaging Hiring Ops so new managers hired after the publish date are auto-enrolled.

Hank: I can do wording review. timeline?

Vera (People Ops): Thanks Hank. Reviews due by 2026-07-04. Publish target 2026-07-20. Training drop-ins: 2026-07-06 & 2026-07-13.

Mina (Hiring Ops): Noted  we'll auto-enroll managers onboarded between 2026-07-20 and 2026-10-20 into a quarterly refresher. I'll need the tracker schema to wire into our onboarding flow.

Omar (Legal): I'll do a legal sweep for country-specific phrasing. Quick note: don't imply contractors are entitled to paid leave. For DE/FR, require documentation when remote exceeds 10 business days.

Sana (Localization): I'll localize after text freeze. Small request: avoid slang like "comp days", use "time-off credits" if needed.

Hank: Wording pass started  added a one-line example about swapping an on-call window and tightened approval steps. Kept tone manager-facing.

Vera (People Ops): Tracker CSV header (exact order, required for nightly exports):
```csv
manager_name,team,email,onboarded_after_publish(yes/no),completed(yes/no),completion_ts,session,verifier,notes
```
We include onboarding flag so Hiring Ops can batch enroll new managers.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled  RSVP ping 9 days before each drop-in; auto-enroll reminder to Hiring Ops on publish date; completion nudge 3 days before publish date.

Mina (Hiring Ops): I can wire the auto-enroll. Send me the tracker link and I'll set the onboarding automation to add new manager rows with onboarded_after_publish=yes. Also will add a field in Workday mapping so emails match.

Omar (Legal): Reviewed  minor edit for DE clause and clarified contractor language. No blockers.

Hank: Final wording submitted. Replaced "manager-approved exception" with "manager attestation for temporary schedule exceptions" to be explicit.

Sana (Localization): Ready to translate FR/DE/ES once finalized. Prefer short sentences for cleaner translation.

Vera (People Ops): Action items: 1) Hank finalize wording by EOD; 2) Omar legal sign-off by 2026-07-04; 3) Mina hook tracker into onboarding pipeline by 2026-07-10; 4) Sana localize after freeze; 5) Vera publish 2026-07-20 and run two 10-min drop-ins. I'll post the PR link here.

Mina (Hiring Ops): I'll also add a column to our onboarding report so People Ops can see which new managers were auto-enrolled.

PeopleOpsBot: Note: managers must use exact CSV header ordering for automated receipts and nightly S3 export to s3://company-compliance/handbook-acks.

Vera (People Ops): PR opened: https://git.company/handbook/policies/schedule-attestation-2026. Please add quick reviews and leave comments inline. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
